text:
Kellner Capital Lifted Its Stake in Akorn (AKRX) as Stock Value Declined; Quantres Asset Management LTD Has Decreased Its Stake in Newell Brands (NWL) as Shares Declined
April 26, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy
Kellner Capital Llc increased its stake in Akorn Inc (AKRX) by 75.94% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kellner Capital Llc bought 32,200 shares as the company’s stock declined 40.46% with the market. The institutional investor held 74,600 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.40M, up from 42,400 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kellner Capital Llc who had been investing in Akorn Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.70B market cap company. The stock increased 0.52% or $0.07 during the last trading session, reaching $13.6. About 3.39 million shares traded or 40.67% up from the average. Akorn, Inc. (NASDAQ:AKRX) has declined 20.35% since April 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 31.90% the S&P500.
Quantres Asset Management Ltd decreased its stake in Newell Brands Inc (NWL) by 72.06% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Quantres Asset Management Ltd sold 44,100 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.87% with the market. The institutional investor held 17,100 shares of the plastic products company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $528,000, down from 61,200 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Quantres Asset Management Ltd who had been investing in Newell Brands Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $13.09 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.81% or $0.22 during the last trading session, reaching $26.96. About 5.79M shares traded. Newell Brands Inc. (NYSE:NWL) has declined 47.20% since April 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 58.75% the S&P500.
Kellner Capital Llc, which manages about $126.19 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Nxp Semiconductors (NASDAQ:NXPI) by 9,000 shares to 212,501 shares, valued at $24.88 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing.
Among 17 analysts covering Akorn Inc ( NASDAQ:AKRX ), 4 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 11 Hold. Therefore 24% are positive. Akorn Inc had 42 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The company was initiated on Thursday, December 1 by Goldman Sachs. The company was maintained on Friday, October 27 by Jefferies. The firm earned “Hold” rating on Monday, November 7 by Wallachbeth. Piper Jaffray maintained the stock with “Hold” rating in Tuesday, August 29 report. The firm earned “Hold” rating on Friday, August 5 by Deutsche Bank. The rating was maintained by Craig Hallum with “Hold” on Monday, April 23. Piper Jaffray maintained the stock with “Hold” rating in Monday, April 23 report. The stock of Akorn, Inc. (NASDAQ:AKRX) earned “Buy” rating by Nomura on Wednesday, December 2. As per Tuesday, August 8, the company rating was maintained by Piper Jaffray. Susquehanna maintained the shares of AKRX in report on Wednesday, March 23 with “Neutral” rating.
Among 20 analysts covering Newell Rubbermaid Inc. ( NYSE:NWL ), 9 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 11 Hold. Therefore 45% are positive. Newell Rubbermaid Inc. had 66 analyst reports since August 4, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. JP Morgan maintained Newell Brands Inc. (NYSE:NWL) rating on Tuesday, February 20. JP Morgan has “Neutral” rating and $26 target. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Thursday, January 25 by Barclays Capital. The stock has “Overweight” rating by Piper Jaffray on Tuesday, December 15. RBC Capital Markets upgraded it to “Top Pick” rating and $60 target in Wednesday, December 16 report. JP Morgan downgraded the shares of NWL in report on Thursday, November 2 to “Neutral” rating. The stock of Newell Brands Inc. (NYSE:NWL) earned “Hold” rating by Jefferies on Thursday, September 14. On Tuesday, October 31 the stock rating was maintained by BMO Capital Markets with “Hold”. The rating was maintained by Wells Fargo with “Buy” on Monday, April 23. Jefferies downgraded the shares of NWL in report on Monday, September 11 to “Hold” rating. BMO Capital Markets maintained it with “Hold” rating and $5100 target in Friday, August 4 report.
Quantres Asset Management Ltd, which manages about $158.73M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Brown Forman Corp (NYSE:BF.B) by 9,500 shares to 14,500 shares, valued at $996,000 in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Zimmer Biomet Holdings Inc (ZMH) by 10,400 shares in the quarter, for a total of 12,300 shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
Analysts await Newell Brands Inc. (NYSE:NWL) to report earnings on May, 14. They expect $0.27 EPS, down 20.59% or $0.07 from last year’s $0.34 per share. NWL’s profit will be $131.12M for 24.96 P/E if the $0.27 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.68 actual EPS reported by Newell Brands Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -60.29% negative EPS growth.
